name: Sapiens
tagline: What it does Give Sapiens a topic and an audience
description: What it does Give Sapiens a topic and an audience. It plans the syllabus, then writes every module out in full — prose, worked examples, diagrams, typeset formulas, and practice placed where it belongs. Why it's different A chat answers the question you thought to ask. A course covers what you didn't know to ask. Sapiens gives you a finished book to read front to back, not a transcript to scroll. Features - Reshape the syllabus before a single lesson is written - Quizzes, flashcards, glossaries
